en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large multi‑storey masonry building with a steep metal roof and a tall corner tower topped by a spire. A smaller domed pavilion stands by the street entrance. The building is surrounded by a wooden picket fence and leafless trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. There are telegraph poles and wires along the street. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
